axis.description: int or tuple of ints Position in the expanded axes where the new axis (or axes) is placed.
constraints: if int, must satisfy 0 <= axis < a.ndim + 1 or -a.ndim - 1 <= axis < 0
if tuple, length must be 1 or 2 and all elements must satisfy the same constraint as int
if axis is deprecated, it must satisfy -rank(input) <= axis < rank(input)

output.description: ------- ndarray View of `a` with the number of dimensions increased.
